admission.justification: The obligation is realized in two reference pages, and a reader who is not told that a limit can clear early would keep waiting or resend into it.

applicability: The product reference pages that describe held-message limits and the runtime's limit file.
conditions: docs/reference/mcp-tools.md names the five-minute recheck, automatic post-limit live-turn suppression, operator provider-limits suppress/unsuppress, and the early drain of held messages.

docs/reference/runtime-layout.md describes provider-limits.json (recheck attempts, recomputed until on partial suppression, and early clear release) and its sibling provider-limit-suppressions.json sidecar written under provider-limits.lock.
exclusions: No dashboard control to check a limit again.
statement: The product reference describes the five-minute recheck, window-scoped automatic and operator suppressions stored in provider-limit-suppressions.json, the early release of held work, and the plug-in's recorded clear time.
title: Product reference covers rechecks, window-scoped suppressions, and release
